_doc: The canonical bytes a merchant signs to ring up a charge on dpay's own OpenCryptoPay till, and the ONE statement of that encoding outside dpay_core::TillOpen. Emitted from the real core by `just wire-layout`; read back by crates/dpay-fixture (which rebuilds the golden struct from these offsets alone) and by scripts/check-wasm-core.mjs (which reproduces the buffer field-by-field in JS and checks the committed wasm's w_till_open_sig against sig_hex). The relay verifies with dpay_core::validate_till_open, so it shares the encoding rather than a copy of it. Same convention as dfx/wire_layout.json — regenerated when the encoding deliberately changes, never hand-edited to make a test pass.
